title: MACHEREY-NAGEL NucleoMag® DNA Microbiome
author: MACHEREY-NAGEL
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Perform sample lysis
steps.instruction: Carry out the lysis of microbiome samples following the NucleoMag® DNA Microbiome user manual.

steps.title: Fill buffer reservoir
steps.instruction: Fill the 12‑well Buffer Reservoir with the reagents indicated in the protocol table.

steps.title: Resuspend magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the NucleoMag® B‑Beads to resuspend them, then place the bead suspension in Position A1 of the 2 mL Tube Rack.

steps.title: Load instrument deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck of the OT‑2 robot according to the displayed positions (deck map).

steps.title: Place lysates on magnetic module
steps.instruction: Put the Square‑well Block that contains the lysates onto the Magnetic Module and start the run on the OT‑2.

steps.title: Execute binding step
steps.instruction: Run the automated Binding Step as defined in the OT‑2 protocol.

steps.title: Perform wash 1
steps.instruction: Run the first automated wash of the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Perform wash 2
steps.instruction: Run the second automated wash of the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Perform wash 3
steps.instruction: Run the third automated wash of the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Perform wash 4
steps.instruction: Run the fourth automated wash of the magnetic beads.

steps.title: Delay for drying
steps.instruction: Allow the beads to dry by pausing the protocol for the specified delay time.

steps.title: Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Execute the automated Elution step to release DNA from the beads.

steps.title: Download protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol archive and unzip it if necessary.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More > Custom Labware > Add Labware and upload any required .json labware files.

steps.title: Upload .py protocol
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) to the OT App via the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck per map
steps.instruction: Arrange the physical deck of the OT‑2 exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration tools.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the automated DNA extraction workflow.
